request:
镜头 s12：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，固定机位略有晃动。研究院会议室，长桌两边坐满了人，主席坐在桌首，平稳地说出决定；宋工坐在长桌最末端，没有表情。墙上的红色镜头亮着。环境声：纸张翻动、空调声、轻咳。
情绪：bureaucratic, cold, decisive
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide shot from the corner of the room, locked-off archival camera with a faint shake
景深与虚实：Deep focus archival video, everything moderately soft from compression.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival institute footage of a committee meeting in 2056: officials and senior engineers sit along a long conference table under cold fluorescent light, the red-glowing lens of the black terminal on the far wall; a grey-haired chairman at the head of the table speaks; Song sits at the far end of the table, listening. Blocking lock: the long table recedes from the foreground to the background; the chairman sits at the head of the table at frame left; Song sits at the far end at frame right; the red lens glows on the far wall at frame centre.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. The committee chairman (a man in his fifties, measured official voice) — 评审会主席（五十多岁男性官员的声音，平稳、官方）: 一个大脑统一调度，效率最高。
现场环境声：papers rustling, air conditioning hum, a dry cough
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

16:9 horizontal, single clip 10.0s, 24fps, observational documentary footage from a research institute's own 2050s film archive, shot on Super 16 colour negative: lively visible grain, slightly soft resolution, cold fluorescent light mixed with one warm desk lamp, muted desaturated palette, deep shadows, imperfect handheld framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.

The long table runs from the foreground to the background; the grey-haired chairman sits at the head of the table at frame left, both hands flat on the table top; Song sits at the far end of the table at frame right, upright and still; the seated officials and engineers fill both edges of the table in the middle ground; the black terminal with its red-glowing lens sits on the far wall at frame centre; the warm desk lamp pools on the table near frame left. Start: the chairman lifts his chin slightly and turns his head toward the length of the table, papers settling under his palm; a few of the seated figures shift and lean in. Middle: he speaks steadily, one hand rising a few centimetres off the table and pressing back down on his words, while the red lens on the wall terminal holds its glow and a man midway down the table clears his throat behind his fist; Song at the far end keeps his hands folded on the table edge, his glasses catching the cold light, his face unchanged. End: the chairman's hand comes to rest, he settles back into his chair, the room goes quiet, and Song is still motionless at frame right with his eyes lowered toward the table top. Mood: bureaucratic, cold, decisive. Blur: deep focus archival video, everything moderately soft from compression; no foreground element pulled out of focus, the far wall and the figures along the table equally soft with grain. The committee chairman (a man in his fifties, measured official voice) says, <d>[Chinese] 一个大脑统一调度，效率最高。</d> Final line of this shot: end on "效率最高。", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

Room tone of a closed conference room, air conditioning hum, papers rustling and being squared against the table, a chair creaking under someone's weight, a dry cough from midway down the table, cloth shifting as seated figures lean in, the chairman's hand tapping once on the table top; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
